content: After nearly three years, Netflix's hard sci-fi series 3 Body Problem is finally returning. On Tuesday, Netflix revealed a first look at 3 Body Problem season 2 in the form of a very expensive-looking teaser trailer and a handful of new stills from the series, which herald the arrival of the destructive aliens known as the San-Ti. The cosmic war between humanity and its would-be exterminators is coming, and it looks spectacular.
